translations.cfgdocs.pdm.pd0.pressure_fouling_dlt.hel: Rise above the clean filter pressure that raises the backwash alert, in bar. Typical range 0.3 to 0.5 bar. The alert is informational only.
translations.cfgdocs.pdm.pd0.pressure_high_th.help: Mechanical safety, in bar: above it the filtration pump is stopped and the alarm latches until acknowledged. Set it from the rated pressure of the filter and valve, not from fouling.
translations.cfgdocs.pdm.pd0.pressure_high_th.label: High pressure cut-off
translations.cfgdocs.pdm.pd0.pressure_ref.help: Pressure measured right after a backwash, in bar. Used as the reference for the fouling alert; it never stops anything. Left at 0 it is learned automatically after 10 min of running with confirmed flow; a value typed in by hand is never overwritten.
translations.cfgdocs.pdm.pd0.pressure_ref.label: Clean filter pressure
translations.cfgdocs.pdm.pd0.pressure_start_dly_s.hel: Time given to the pump to prime before pressure and flow are watched, in seconds. Too short and a normal priming looks like a loss of flow.
translations.cfgdocs.pdm.pd0.pump_flow_m3h.help: Actual filtration pump flow rate in m³/h. The daily need is pool volume × cycles(temperature) ÷ pump flow.
translations.cfgdocs.pdm.pd0.pump_flow_m3h.label: Pump flow rate (m³/h)
translations.cfgdocs.wildcard.depends_on_mask.label: Dependency mask
translations.cfgdocs.wildcard.enabled.help: Declares the device as present on the installation.
translations.cfgdocs.wildcard.enabled.label: Device installed
translations.cfgdocs.wildcard.flow_l_h.help: Nominal flow rate in litres per hour, used to compute injected volumes.
translations.cfgdocs.wildcard.flow_l_h.label: Flow rate (L/h)
translations.cfgdocs.wildcard.max_uptime_day_s.help: Maximum allowed runtime per day for this device.
translations.cfgdocs.wildcard.max_uptime_day_s.label: Max daily runtime (s)
translations.cfgdocs.wildcard.on_delay_s.help: Delay between the run request and actual power-on. 0 means immediate start. Stopping stays immediate.
translations.cfgdocs.wildcard.on_delay_s.label: Switch-on delay
translations.cfgdocs.wildcard.tank_cap_ml.help: Maximum capacity of the tank associated with this device.
translations.cfgdocs.wildcard.tank_cap_ml.label: Tank capacity (mL)
translations.cfgdocs.wildcard.tank_init_ml.label: Initial tank level (mL)
